title: NASA-UAP-D021, Gemini 7 Technical Debriefing, 1965
doc_notes: This is a technical debriefing transcript for the Gemini 7 mission, which contains one brief mention of a satellite sighting. / This is a technical debriefing transcript for the Gemini 7 mission; no UAP or anomalous encounters are reported.

encounters.summary: Astronauts sighted a satellite passing underneath their spacecraft during orbital flight.
encounters.quote: we sighted a satellite much lower and on a slightly higher inclination path than we were.
